title: Ambiguous Actionable Log Statements
pattern: Logging a message that commands or hints at an action ("Reset required") without explicitly declaring whether the action is executed automatically by the software or demands manual human intervention.
why_bad: Trains operators to react with superstitions or "witchcraft" during outages (e.g. executing dangerous manual database failovers during peak hours because they misinterpret an automated system informational message) [698-700].
detection: Presence of passive voice or ambiguous imperative commands inside diagnostic error strings without actor attribution.
fix: Revise the wording to explicitly declare whether the system is currently executing the resolution step automatically.
